description: SMOTE oversampling: precision collapsed from 0.77 to 0.30, F1 dropped from 0.78 to 0.45

asi.hypothesis: SMOTE would improve minority class detection
asi.rollback_reason: SMOTE created too many false positives. The model learned to label everything as fraud. SMOTE generates synthetic fraud samples from only 378 real ones, creating unrealistic patterns.
asi.next_action_hint: Try threshold optimization instead — find optimal decision boundary for F1 maximization rather than resampling.
